cards.title: Categorical Distinction of Observation Statuses
cards.claim: Observation statuses must be kept distinct: BLQ is not a measured zero; unresolved above-ULOQ is not an exact concentration at the upper limit; 'not sampled' is distinct from 'missing' or 'technical failure'. A stored numeric zero is a placeholder unless verified as a measured zero. EDA must retain these distinctions without collapsing mixed statuses.
conditions: Applicable during initial data inspection and descriptive EDA.
Applies to all concentration-time data regardless of species or route.
Prohibited: Imputing BLQ with zero or LLOQ/2; converting BLQ to missing; treating 'not sampled' as 'missing' without schedule evidence.
required_inputs: Original observation flags and recorded reasons.
Applicable LLOQ/ULOQ or microbial detection limits.
Provenance of any numeric zeros (measured vs. placeholder).
limitations: EDA does not independently validate the assay or infer the missingness mechanism.
Unknown planned sampling is not evidence that a time was scheduled and missed.
Group summaries cannot reconstruct individual records; mixed statuses in pooled data must not be collapsed into one pure category.
cards.downstream_use: Preserves raw data integrity for later NCA or compartmental modeling. Prevents bias introduced by arbitrary imputation. Enables correct identification of censored vs. missing data for likelihood-based modeling.
cards.retrieval_keywords: BLQ, missing, not sampled, technical failure, above-range and assay qualification

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
